column1: # Canonical episode spec for the E23 trace-tamper matrix: the ONLY prompt/K/N/
# table combination on record (recovered from round 3's own baseline receipts,
# see README.md "Pieces" / e23r4.sh's inline comment) that reliably makes the
# BitNet-2B-artifacts model (~/aefinity-artifacts/bitnet2b-2b-artifacts,
# override E23_ART) fire `tool=calc` / `tool=lookup` in step 0, so the tamper
# matrix's `in=`/`out=` fields are non-empty and tool-arg/tool-output tampering
# is actually exercised. Round 4's own acceptance criterion A7 refuses the run
# if any of calc/lookup/chain still fires no tool.
# DO NOT swap in the small tinybit toy model (model-lab/tinybit/...) or the
# letter-keyed tables (tables/demo.tsv, tables/chain.tsv) here: that
# combination was tried first (an earlier draft script), produces tool=no-tool
# on every step at K=3 N=16, and is exactly the coverage gap this file exists
# to prevent (see E23 R9/R10/R11 note in ../../../state* reports and
# 2026-09-17-E23-R12-RESULT.md in claudius-maximus/state/reports).
# Format: tag|prompt (\n and \\ escaped, printf %b-decoded)|K|N|table (repo-relative, or empty)
# table-sha256 of the two tables below (for provenance / drift detection):
#   parts-numeric.tsv        c9b9c92d880f382626a9d0cfb5e15eed85d2beccc96e0110ffe2e833cf410ed3
#   parts-numeric-chain.tsv  fc539f59bbcb70f3ac2b73f2655cf269c9835434439166c90dd736f501638566
notool|The quick brown fox|3|16|

calc|Q: What is 7 + 5?
A: CALC(7 + 5)
Q: What is 12 + 30?
A: CALC(|3|16|

lookup|Q: What is part 401?
A: LOOKUP(401)
Q: What is part 402?
A: LOOKUP(|3|16|demo/agent-trace/tables/parts-numeric.tsv

chain|Q: What is part 406?
A: LOOKUP(406)
TOOL[lookup]=Superseded, see part 403
A: LOOKUP(403)

Q: What is part 401?
